propositions: Replace duplicate pass-record producers with single process-finalizer writer that records minimal schema to refs/reconciler/last-pass before releasing refs/reconciler/lock using observed-OID CAS with exactly three attempts and 100ms/200ms backoff.

Canonical rebar bridge status and hidden bridge-status alias must be identical read-only entrypoints exposing HEALTHY/PAUSED/RUNNING/STALE/FOREIGN/NEVER_RUN/FAILED verdicts with total precedence and matching exit codes.
Status target derives from explicit REBAR_ENV_ID or local:<repo-env-id> from .env-id; missing/empty/.env-id is hard error; inbound event metadata and LEGACY_JIRA_ENV_ID remain unchanged.

Canary rolls from GitHub Actions heartbeat polling to durable status source by defaulting REBAR_CANARY_HEARTBEAT_SOURCE to status after one last-pass write, retaining explicit github-api rollback for one release.

Crash detection uses two read-only live-lock snapshots across observed lease_secs (default 120, reject >480s immediately); RUNNING and CRASHED use live lock snapshot while recorded fence is provenance only.
